This is a primary empirical journal article with abstract, methods, results, discussion and references, pp. 422–429, rather than an abstract-only excerpt or secondary report. No PDF was assigned. Original side and replication p are unassigned placeholders. Target ambiguity: no replication test locator; do not choose among omnibus or pairwise comparisons from the broad description. Candidate omnibus: F(2, 891) = 5.79, p = .003, printed ηp2 = .013, p. 426. Candidate Bonferroni tests: easy versus challenging fiction p = .008; easy fiction versus nonfiction p = .013; challenging fiction versus nonfiction p > .99. No Cohen d is printed for these observed transportation tests; d = .22 on p. 424 is a power-analysis input, not an observed result. No conversion performed. Candidate common three-condition final analytic sample N = 894 is explicitly printed on p. 424 after excluding 111 of 1,005 respondents for attention-check performance below 60%; 218 reporting prior exposure were retained. Explicit mutually exclusive final randomized groups: challenging fiction 296, easy fiction 300, nonfiction 298; 296 + 300 + 298 = 894. This common omnibus sample is retained only as candidate evidence for parent field-scope review because the row-specific critical test is unresolved. Pairwise group totals have not been substituted. Narrative replication verdict is explicitly failed, independently of the significant omnibus condition effect.
